brief: A 1970s small-town church: a single-storey building of white siding under a low brown gable roof with a projecting gabled entry porch clad in brown board, a painted signboard 'Church of Christ' on the ridge, shrubs and a car park. One photo; year estimated. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
